copy.description: Walking a cat on a leash starts with a harness that fits. This vest-style cat harness has locking side buckles. Dual side slide adjusters let you change the length for a range of chest sizes, and a one-touch side buckle makes it quick to put on and take off. Dual thickened stainless steel D-rings give you two attachment points for a leash. The body is 3D air mesh fabric, which is breathable and soft. Reflective edge strips add visibility on night walks. Each harness ships in a plastic bag. If you want a breathable cat harness with reflective edging, this one is worth a look. The adjusters cover various chest sizes across small, medium, and large cats. Check the shipping estimate before you order.

faq.q: How do I size the harness?
faq.a: It has dual side slide adjusters for various chest sizes, and it comes in sizes S to XL for small to large cats. Measure your cat's chest before you order.
The body is 3D air mesh fabric that is breathable and soft. The D-rings are thickened stainless steel.
Estimated 3–7 business days to the US, plus processing 1–3 days. These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates.

copy.safety_warning: Check the fit before every walk and supervise your cat while it wears the harness. No harness can guarantee a pet cannot slip out.
copy.shipping_estimate: Estimated 3–7 business days to the US, plus processing 1–3 days.
